Response.description: Success response to vtc/elections/ballot-boxes/list/0.1: every voting service the community trusts, as it trusts them now.

ballotBoxes.description: Every trusted ballot box, in the community's own order. Empty when the community trusts none, and so can create no election.

Response.title: VTC Elections — Ballot Boxes — List — response payload

TrustedBallotBox.description: One voting service the community trusts (VTI-VOT-082), with what its members are told about it when an election names it (VTI-VOT-090).

did.description: The ballot box's DID, exactly as a manifest names it in `ballotBox`.

operator.description: Who operates it, as the community names them — the `ballotBoxOperator` a member is shown.

sameOperator.description: Whether the party operating the community's VTC also operates this ballot box — the `sameOperator` a member is shown.
